## Triage: re-graded `priority:p3` → `priority:p1` · `security` added · `finding` removed. Graded on its worst reading under the may-leak-data exception; the first step is the measurement this card names

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T07:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`candidateFields` → `filterFields`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a published library in objectui. A server-side half, if the measurement finds one, is an objectstack card.

- **Why p1:** the card's worst reading is a field-level-security bypass by elimination. This is the same exception triage applied to objectstack-ai/objectstack#22168 in R242: grade on the worst reading, then measure. If either guard the card names holds, the measurement closes the card, or re-grades it as a client-consistency fix.
- **Why `security`:** the class is authorization. ⛔ From here on, keep this card abstract: classes, positions, files and functions. Do not post request recipes, field names or values.
- **Either way, the client fix is right:** the filter field list uses the same `checkField` read as the columns, so the two lists cannot drift.

Claim: PM loop round 9
Session: `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`
Account: `huangyiirene`
Branch: `claude/issue-11925-filter-field-read`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11925`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface (line numbers on `main` `4ebc250`, read 2026-10-08T07:58Z):
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: the Filter panel's field list only (`candidateFields` → `filterFields`). It applies the same field-level read check the list's columns already use (`perms.checkField(…, 'read')`), so the two field lists cannot drift.
- The tests beside it, and `.changeset/11925-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- The columns' own checks and every other part of `ListView.tsx`.
- The URL state of the list (objectui#11860, in re-triage).
- The server, and any `packages/spec/**`. A server-side half, if the measurement finds one, goes to the seat in the dev's report and is not written publicly.
- `packages/components/src/ui/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this path: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui plugin-list ListView: the Filter panel's field list applies no field-level read check while the columns do (measure reach first, per triage 6055396453) | the platform path is right: the field-level check the columns use is the published one, and the client mirrors it | every list user whose permission set hides a field`
Thread-read: `6055396453`
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **Security posture:** this claim, its PR and its reports stay abstract, per triage `6055396453`: classes, positions, files and functions only. No request recipe, field name or value is written publicly.
- **`area:access` in flight:** this seat's objectui#11902 (PR objectui#11929, in CI; `RecordDetailView.tsx`) and seat 3's objectui#11866 (the profile page). Both are disjoint from `ListView.tsx`.
- **The same file:** objectui#11860 (seat 2's former claim) is back in `pm:queue` with `pm:retriage` and no dev, and objectui#11816 is closed. No open PR touches `ListView.tsx`. Read 2026-10-08T07:58Z.
- **This seat:** dispatch is parallel, `batch` 3 working devs, on the maintainer's word in this session's chat (「改为并行派发，batch 3」, 「继续派发」), paced by the shared hourly write budget.
  - objectui#11902's dev has finished (PR objectui#11929), which freed this slot.
  - Working with this card: objectui#11895's dev and objectui#11898's.

Why `Clause-②: no`: a narrower field list inside the list's own Filter panel. No export, prop, `@object-ui/types` member or accepted input changes.
